_comment: Owner direction on WO-F09-04: "Can you make the path and roads electrified with yellow electricity flowing through them somehow in the ground." Every Stormwood route and spur carries yellow-gold current in its painted dirt lane: broken glowing veins like charge in cracks of the dirt, with pulses travelling along them toward the Dynamo. Built by scripts/world/stormwood_road_current.gd as terrain-conforming ribbon chunks (client presentation only; no colliders; no per-frame script) drawn by shaders/stormwood_road_current.gdshader, additive and unshaded. Kept apart from stormwood_road_surface.json so tuning the look never stales the terrain bake. Yellow/gold only: magenta #ff40e6 is the lightning strike telegraph and oxblood/red is reserved for Team Tether.
_comment_width: Ribbon half-width is width_fraction x the route kind's lane_half_width_m in stormwood_road_surface.json, so the current stays inside the painted dirt; the shader feathers its edge to nothing well before the ribbon edge.
_comment_depth: Terrain3D coarsens its far mesh, so a ribbon conforming to the full-detail height can dip under it. The vertex shader pulls each vertex toward the camera along its own view ray by depth_pull of its distance: a depth bias only, it does not move the ribbon on screen.

reduced_motion._comment: motion_prefs.reduced_motion(): the current still flows, slowly, as a steady glow with no flicker.

storm_intensity._comment: Shader uniform storm_intensity (0..1) by Surge phase, read every poll_s from StormwoodSurge.phase (the surge has no phase signal) and eased over ease_s. aftermath applies once aftermath_flag (the Long Storm's end, which stormwood_surge.gd also reads) is set.

_comment_flow: Current flows toward the Dynamo: each open route flows from the end farther from dynamo_xz to the nearer end. A closed loop (first point equals last) has no nearer end and flows in its polyline order.
